children: VERDE RESOURCES, INC. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $467.8K, up 251% from $133.2K a year earlier, while the company recorded a net loss of $(3.38M) for the year, an improvement from a $(4.78M) loss in FY 2025.
Revenue was $467.8K for FY 2026, compared with $133.2K in FY 2025; YoY change 251%.
Net income (loss) was $(3.38M) for FY 2026, compared with $(4.78M) in FY 2025; YoY change (29%).
Diluted earnings per share: Not reported in the provided sections and therefore omitted.

Revenue growth of 251% was driven by initial commercial sales to Ergon and Verde V24 purchase orders as the company shifted to supplying engineered biochar through an exclusive collaboration with Ergon and MCCA for North America.
Operational milestone: NCAT lab validation confirmed a 100% RAP BioAsphalt™ cold recycling mix that met or exceeded tested specifications.
Brand and market entry momentum included the first certified asphalt carbon removal credit issued by Puro.earth and an exclusive North America licensing arrangement with Ergon.

Global expansion plans highlighted a restart plan for the BioFraction facility in Borneo targeted for 2027 and a Singapore memorandum of understanding aimed at a pilot with the Land Transport Authority as a regional launchpad.
